text:
claire: quick eyes please — PR #4857 updates NATGW route propagation for the gpu-subnet in prod. It's a small tf change to enable propagation and adjust the route table association. plan looks clean but this touches routing tables so want one infra owner +1 before canary tonight. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4857 :eyes:

infra-ci-bot: terraform plan (canary-eu-west-1):
```
Plan: 3 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy
+ aws_route.propagated_route
~ aws_route_table_association.gpu_assoc (attributes changed)
```

josh: can you paste the exact route table id and the attribute diff? want to ensure it's not the shared egress RT we use for other clusters.

claire: sure — route table is `rtb-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8` (gpu-subnet-eu). Diff snippet: 
```hcl
resource "aws_route" "propagated_route" {
  route_table_id         = "rtb-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8"
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  gateway_id             = aws_nat_gateway.gpu_nat.id
  depends_on             = [aws_route_table_association.gpu_assoc]
}
resource "aws_route_table_association" "gpu_assoc" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.gpu_subnet.id
  route_table_id = var.gpu_route_table_id # previously hardcoded to rtb-shared-1
}
```
This switches the gpu subnet to its dedicated route table and enables propagation so NATGW routes show up automatically.

nina: can you run the plan against the canary account (canary-eu) and post the plan id? want to make sure there's no surprises with the association change.

claire: done — canary plan: https://ci.redwood.ai/plan/90021 shows the same 3 adds / 1 change, no deletes. Logs: no ENI detach predicted.

maria: +1 from me. Looks safe but please monitor ENI detach logs and route propagation metrics during the canary. If we see >5% 5m ENI detach spike or CPU >80% on the natgw nodes, rollback immediately. :thumbsup:

kevin: heads up — backup jobs run at 22:00 UTC, try not to merge then. When are you planning to start the canary?

claire: good catch. planning to start canary at 01:30 UTC to avoid backup window. Canary timeline: 30m in eu-west-1 (10% of GPU pool), then 30m ramp to 50%, monitor. Rollback plan is `terraform apply -target=aws_route_table_association.gpu_assoc` revert to previous var value and then re-apply.

josh: LGTM, leaving a formal review comment on the PR. :eyes:

infra-ci-bot: canary apply scheduled — execution id 2165006000, ETA 2165007000

deploy-bot: scheduled canary apply for infra/pr/4857 at 01:30 UTC. Alerting: #incidents and #eng-oncall will get heartbeat checks.

claire: thanks everyone — will ping back with quick status after the 30m canary.
